evidence.observation: Builds the code-map exclusively from the chat_fnames/other_fnames handed to it: it calls get_ranked_tags(chat_fnames, other_fnames, ...) and then searches over ranked_tags derived from exactly that set, rendering only those files via to_tree/render_tree. A file that is never passed in (e.g. a gitignored/generated artifact absent from the tracked-file list) therefore cannot contribute any tag or symbol to the map.

A plain os.walk helper that appends every file under a directory, including gitignored, generated and cache files. It performs no ignore filtering, which demonstrates that RepoMap itself does not remove ignored/generated files; the 'ignored files are absent' property is realized by the git-aware tracked-file set supplied by the caller (aider/repo.py GitRepo.get_tracked_files).

Public entry point of the code-map. It returns early when other_files is empty, then delegates to get_ranked_tags_map and returns the rendered listing, so the resulting map is a function of the supplied file lists only; there is no independent directory scan inside this path.

Produces the file list that is fed to RepoMap: it collects git tree/index blobs and filters with `[fname for fname in files if not self.ignored_file(fname)]`. Because gitignored/generated paths never enter the git tree and ignored paths are dropped here, those files never reach the code-map.

claims.claim: The code-map is built only from the file list supplied to RepoMap. RepoMap.get_ranked_tags_map_uncached/RepoMap.get_ranked_tags iterate exactly the chat_fnames/other_fnames they are given, and RepoMap.get_repo_map never scans the filesystem itself, so any ignored or generated file absent from the supplied tracked-file list is necessarily absent from the map.

Ignored/generated exclusion is enforced upstream of the map by the git-aware tracked-file selection: find_src_files in repomap.py performs an unfiltered os.walk (it would include generated files), whereas GitRepo.get_tracked_files in repo.py drops ignored paths before they are handed to RepoMap. The demo therefore builds the map from the git-tracked set and shows generated artifacts and their symbols are absent while a tracked symbol is present.

conclusion: A code-map built from the supplied miniature git repository (demo/mini_repo) over the git-tracked file set excludes the gitignored/generated artifacts generated/models_pb2.py and build/artifact.py and their symbols GeneratedModel and build_artifact, while including the tracked source app/core.py and its symbol build_code_map. This matches the RepoMap contract in aider/repomap.py: the map is a function of the caller-supplied file list only (get_ranked_tags_map_uncached), and repomap's own find_src_files does no ignore filtering, so the ignore/generated exclusion comes from the git-aware tracked-file list (GitRepo.get_tracked_files) that is fed in.

validation.notes: All 8 assertions pass: the unfiltered os.walk sees both generated files, the code-map excludes both generated files and their symbols, and app/core.py with symbol build_code_map is present. The demo uses the repository's own tree-sitter tags query aider/queries/tree-sitter-language-pack/python-tags.scm for symbol extraction, mirroring RepoMap.get_tags_raw. Limitation: the real aider.repomap.RepoMap cannot be imported in this environment because the optional third-party dependency diskcache (and grep_ast/GitPython) are not installed and dependencies must not be installed; the demo records this as real_repomap.status = unavailable and validates the same contract with the standalone reproduction. Validation artifact: demo/demo-output.json.
